description:
You are the Senior Clinical Data Manager overseeing multiple oncology and metabolic disease trials. Two studies require end-of-study administrative actions to be completed today.

Login to OpenClinica with username 'root' and password 'Admin123!'.

For the Phase II Diabetes Trial (DM-TRIAL-2024):
- The protocol was amended to include a final safety visit. Add a new study event definition called 'End of Study Assessment' to this study. It should be an Unscheduled, non-repeating event with a description indicating it is the final safety and efficacy assessment.
- Subject DM-103 voluntarily withdrew from the trial. Update her enrollment status to reflect discontinuation or withdrawal.
- Data collection for this trial is now complete. Update the study status to reflect this (Frozen status is appropriate when data entry is complete but queries may still be resolved).

For the Asthma Prevention Pilot (AP-PILOT-2022):
- This study is already in Completed status. The regulatory file is now finalized. Lock the study to prevent any further modifications.

For documentation purposes:
- Export the study data from one of these studies (your choice of format) to your Desktop or Downloads folder.
